summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin, without running tests or committing. Changes: Update class added to sparql.py beside Query; translateUpdate in algebra.py returns an Update on every path (empty request uses translatePrologue([], base, initNs) and an empty algebra list); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py mirroring prepareQuery and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_prepared_update.py covers the workflows in the spec, including a deep-copy no-mutation check. Not verified: tests were not run and black formatting was not checked, per the instructions. The least certain parts are the Graph.update calls with initBindings and the Prologue.base assertion in the empty-request test.
